description: Where Claude Code is, read off the screen of the window it was resumed in after a move, so a device types the move note only at Claude Code's empty prompt while it is not working, and shows a banner instead of pressing a key in every question Claude Code asks (folder trust, Bypass Permissions, resume from a summary, signing in, a tool's permission, any other numbered choice). Both clients (web/src/lib/move/screen.ts, mobile/src/data/selectors/claude-screen.ts) embed exactly this table, minus description, source, checked_against and fixtures, and classify every fixture as expected. proto/README.md, 'Reading Claude Code's screen after a move', states the rules; version moves whenever a state's meaning or the way a screen is read changes.
source: Captured fixtures come from Claude Code 2.1.289 driven in a sandboxed HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR against a local stub of the Messages API on 127.0.0.1, never Anthropic, and rendered by xterm.js at 50 and 100 columns. The rest are laid out as those captures and spike S1's (2.1.288 in the same kind of sandbox) are, with Claude Code's wording read out of the installed 2.1.288 and 2.1.289 binaries with grep, each shell's own not-found message, or text a person, Claude's reply or a host's name can put on the screen; each fixture's source says which. A fixture's lines are the screen's logical lines (a row xterm wrapped joined to the row before it), top to bottom, as a client reads them.
